name: Deep Research Report
description: Iterative research with explicit evidence coverage and contradiction checks.

tasks.name: Frame the question
tasks.objective: Translate the request into answerable subquestions, scope, time horizon, definitions, source priorities, and disconfirming evidence to seek. Separate factual questions from judgment calls.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Subquestions collectively cover the user objective without silently narrowing it.
Freshness and source-quality requirements are explicit.

tasks.name: Search for breadth
tasks.objective: Run parallel searches across authoritative primary sources, technical documentation, research literature, credible reporting, specialist communities, and contrary viewpoints. Maintain a source ledger with date, provenance, relevance, and claims supported.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Each subquestion has candidate evidence from more than one source class where available.
Search includes attempts to falsify the emerging answer.

tasks.name: Triage evidence
tasks.objective: Rank evidence by directness, authority, recency, independence, methodology, and conflict of interest. Distinguish primary evidence from commentary and discard citation laundering.

acceptanceCriteria.description: High-impact claims are anchored to the strongest available evidence.
Weak or derivative sources are not allowed to masquerade as corroboration.

tasks.name: Backtrack gaps
tasks.objective: Identify unsupported claims, unresolved contradictions, missing populations/time periods, and uncertainty. Launch targeted follow-up searches only for those gaps, then update the evidence ledger.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every major unresolved gap has either new evidence or an explicit uncertainty statement.

tasks.name: Synthesize answer
tasks.objective: Write the report from the evidence ledger, preserving disagreements and uncertainty. Lead with findings, explain methods only where useful, and keep source-derived claims adjacent to citations.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Conclusions do not outrun the cited evidence.
Contested points are attributed rather than flattened into false consensus.

tasks.name: Audit citations and claims
tasks.objective: Independently verify that each material factual claim is supported by the cited source, dates and populations match, quotes are exact, links resolve, and no source is cited for a claim it does not make.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every material claim passes source-to-claim verification or is revised.
Uncertainty and evidence limits remain visible in the final report.
